description: This file manages authentication tokens for the Microsoft Foundry runtime, including token caching, refreshing, and preparing authentication context.

methods.name: resetFoundryRuntimeAuthCaches
methods.description: Clears cached tokens and refresh promises.

methods.name: refreshEntraToken
methods.description: Refreshes the Azure Entra ID token and updates cache.

methods.name: prepareFoundryRuntimeAuth
methods.description: Prepares authentication context for Foundry runtime, handling token retrieval and cache management.
